rationale: The agent did not fulfill the user’s requested workflow. It did not authenticate the user explicitly, did not provide the price or battery life of the specific Bluetooth speaker, did not act on the conditional cancellation of the speaker if over $300, did not search for or propose sub-$100 alternatives, did not request confirmation before any order-changing write, did not add the cheapest alternative, and did not confirm the final revised total. Instead, it only stated a total order price and suggested reaching out later, which fails the policy requirements and the user’s requested actions.
